entries.api: topologies.training.losses:get_loss('a2c')(logits_or_prediction, targets, *, value, returns, entropy, entropy_coefficient=0.01, reduction='mean', ignore_index=None)
entries.description: Per-sample actor-critic objective from selected-action log probabilities, detached advantages and returns, value predictions, and policy entropies; rollout and distribution calculations remain caller-owned.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def rollouts(ctx):
    state = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    action = int(ctx.index) % 2
    advantage = float(int(ctx.index) % 5 - 2)
    returns = float(int(ctx.index) % 3 - 1)
    inputs = torch.cat((state, torch.tensor([float(action)])))
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(inputs), "advantage": synth.Tensor(torch.tensor(advantage)), "returns": synth.Tensor(torch.tensor(returns))}
class ActorCritic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=3)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        raw = self.network(inputs[..., :4])
        log_probabilities = torch.log_softmax(raw[..., :2], dim=-1)
        actions = inputs[..., 4].long().unsqueeze(-1)
        log_probability = log_probabilities.gather(-1, actions).squeeze(-1)
        probabilities = log_probabilities.exp()
        entropy = -(probabilities * log_probabilities).sum(dim=-1)
        return {"log_probability": log_probability, "value": raw[..., 2], "entropy": entropy}
ds = synth.Spec("a2c-rollouts", generator=rollouts, size=12, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
trainer = Trainer(ActorCritic(), train, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "a2c", "loss_kwargs": {"entropy_coefficient": 0.01, "reduction": "mean"}, "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "log_probability"}, "targets": {"batch": "advantage"}, "value": {"output": "value"}, "returns": {"batch": "returns"}, "entropy": {"output": "entropy"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train an actor-critic model with A2C

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 x=torch.randn(6,generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 return {"inputs":synth.Tensor(x),"targets":synth.Tensor((x[:2]>0).float())}
ds=synth.Spec("sigmoid-focal",generator=samples,size=16,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("regression",split="train",input_field="inputs",target_field="targets",preserve_shape=True)
val=ds.for_recipe("regression",split="val",like=train,input_field="inputs",target_field="targets",preserve_shape=True)
model=build("mlp","tiny",in_features=6,out_features=2)
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="regression",recipe_config={"loss":"sigmoid-focal","loss_kwargs":{"gamma":2.0}},max_epochs=1,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)

import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 x=torch.randn(6,generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 return {"features":x,"labels":int(x[0]>0)}
ds=synth.Spec("softmax-focal",generator=samples,size=16,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify",split="train")
val=ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify",split="val",like=train)
model=build("mlp","tiny",in_features=6,out_features=2)
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="tabular-classify",recipe_config={"loss":"softmax-focal","loss_kwargs":{"gamma":2.0}},max_epochs=1,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
